items.title: Witch Sorting Moon Mail
items.alt: A bespectacled witch sorts blank envelopes into a wooden mail tray.
items.description: A friendly witch sorts three blank envelopes into a small wooden mail tray with crescent-shaped handle cutouts. Use this illustration for letter-writing inspiration and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Watering Moonflowers
items.alt: A witch waters two white moonflowers and a closed bud in a pot.
items.description: A witch gently tilts a small watering can over a pot with two open white moonflowers and one closed bud. Use this illustration for plant care sequence cards and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Caring for a Baby Dragon
items.alt: An elderly witch cradles a small green dragon in a soft blanket.
items.description: A seated witch wraps a tiny friendly green dragon in a soft blanket, its two wings folded and its tail visible. Use this illustration for kindness and care stories and personal crafts.
